summary: TerrAscend Corp. filed an 8-K on June 29, 2026, announcing a preliminary proxy statement for a special meeting to vote on a share consolidation (reverse stock split) of its common, exchangeable, and preferred shares. No definitive terms (ratio, price per share, premium) are disclosed; the filing is a procedural update. The board has not yet made a formal recommendation, and no advisor is named. The company is Canadian, trading OTCQX, and the proxy solicitation follows SEC and SEDAR+ requirements. Watch for the definitive proxy with consolidation ratio and meeting date; risk-arb angle is minimal as this is structural, not transactional.
